findings.label: About tab label missing variation selector
findings.detail: Tab labels render as 'ℹ About' (U+2139 + space) rather than the planned 'ℹ️ About' (with U+FE0F variation selector). Cosmetic only — the About tab is present and functional on all 18 sections. Normalize the glyph to 'ℹ️' if label consistency with the plan matters.
